We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for this case. Facts: Defendant Lü 3 (吕3某) in July 2015, without repayment ability, fabricated reasons (lack of guarantee deposit for contracted project) and twice defrauded victim Xie 4 (谢某4) total 42,000 RMB. Evidence includes victim statements, witness testimonies, bank transaction details, loan documents, defendant's statements. Prosecutor says behavior violates Criminal Law, constitutes ... (unspecified) and is a repeat offender (累犯). Also after sentencing, discovered other crimes before sentencing, need concurrent sentencing.
